subject.title: Intermittent 30+ minute workspace-sandbox prep on cold-start (5.19-beta.1)

question: Should OpenClaw add a default Docker sandbox init deadline/fail-soft behavior for cold-start hangs, and what timeout/config boundary should be accepted for existing slow Docker setups?
rationale: Current main still has unbounded Docker waits, but changing them to fail fast can alter behavior for existing users with slow Docker control-plane operations.

options.title: Refresh the timeout PR
options.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR, document the default/config boundary, and require real wedged-Docker proof before merge.

options.title: Keep investigating first
options.body: Keep this issue open for logs or live reproduction before accepting a default timeout behavior.

options.title: Decline default fail-fast behavior
options.body: Close the timeout direction only if maintainers decide slow Docker setups should remain unbounded or externally managed.

recommendation.title: Refresh the timeout PR
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR, document the default/config boundary, and require real wedged-Docker proof before merge.
